project.name: oriah-jpa-base
project.description:
Shared JPA building blocks for the 10 entity-bearing services: AuditableEntity (a @MappedSuperclass that gives every entity created_at / created_by / updated_at / updated_by audit columns plus an is_deleted soft-delete column, all auto-populated by Spring Data Auditing + Hibernate's @SoftDelete), and KeycloakAuditorAware (resolves "who changed this row" from the JWT in the SecurityContext, or "system" for Kafka-consumer threads where there is no SecurityContext).
Each entity-bearing service declares this dependency AND a per-service JpaConfig @Configuration that flips on @EnableJpaAuditing(auditorAwareRef = "auditor") and registers the auditor bean. Putting the activation per-service (rather than via @AutoConfiguration in this jar) keeps it out of @WebMvcTest slices, which would otherwise fail with "JPA metamodel must not be empty."
Services WITHOUT JPA entities (configserver / eurekaserver / gatewayserver / shipping / checkout) do NOT declare a dependency on this jar, so their classpaths do not get spring-data-* transitively. That isolation matters: an earlier attempt put these deps in oriah-observability-starter (which every module depends on) and broke spring-cloud-openfeign 5.x's Encoder wiring on checkout. See docs/PROGRESS.md "Why T1.6 was harder than expected" for the post-mortem.
